mapper.select: SELECT sr.id, sr.create_time, sr.code, sr.source_id, srd.source_detail_id, sr.source_code, sr.type, sr.approve_status, sr.invalid_status, sr.customer_id, sr.sales_org_id, sr.seller_id, srd.sku_id, srd.sku_no, srd.sales_qty, srd.return_qty, sr.bill_date, sr.approve_user_name, sr.create_user_name FROM so_return_detail srd INNER JOIN so_return sr ON srd.main_id = sr.id AND srd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sr.is_deleted = FALSE
